fact: The drivers and team manager were not present at the scheduled time of the online drivers briefing.
incident_time: 18:25 The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 20) and heard from the drivers and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Alleged breach of Article 20.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 23 (Alexander Albon), the driver of Car 43 (Franco Colapinto) and the team representative. The team manager explained that the team attempted to log into the video meeting but was unable to do so as the attempt was rejected by the software provider. The drivers then attempted to log in using their phones, but only one was successful and joined the meeting partway through. The team provided a printout of the message received by the software provider and the Stewards are satisfied that a genuine attempt was made to attend the meeting. The drivers and team manager agreed to meet with the Race Director to obtain any information conveyed at the meeting. Accordingly the Stewards take no further action.
rules_referenced: Article 20.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Williams Failure To Attend Drivers Meeting
